# bootstrap-multiselect runtime provenance

This directory records the Bootstrap 5 multiselect package bundled by the
PastureStack Web Console.

- Upstream package: `bootstrap-multiselect`
- Upstream version: `2.0.0`
- Upstream repository: `https://github.com/davidstutz/bootstrap-multiselect`
- Upstream tarball: `https://registry.npmjs.org/bootstrap-multiselect/-/bootstrap-multiselect-2.0.0.tgz`
- npm integrity: `sha512-m8dTwF+mLlpt8PtXfAXyERJLOGNuNrVuU9aQi2WMfwfwSzhgN+LbTaRuTk8Y15NZiMzy2m/FPfhKKgOOJxk2WQ==`
- License: Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause, retained in `LICENSE.md`

Version `2.0.0` is the upstream Bootstrap 5 release. The former vendored
`0.9.10` JavaScript and CSS are not retained.
